meta.title: LipoNexus | First Blood Test for Early Detection of Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD)
meta.description: LipoNexus is the first and only accurate non-invasive blood test for Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD) using inflammatory lipid biomarkers. 95%+ accuracy, 99% specificity — via a simple blood draw.

hero.headline: The First Blood Test for Early Detection of Fatty Liver Disease
hero.subheadline: LipoNexus delivers the first non-invasive blood test for early detection and diagnosis of Fatty Liver Disease (MASLD) through inflammatory lipid biomarkers — 95%+ accuracy, 99% specificity, via a simple blood draw.

problem.headline: MASLD: The Next Emerging Healthcare Crisis
problem.body: Metabolic Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) is the leading cause of chronic liver disease, impaired liver function, and early death. 1 in 3 Americans has MASLD — yet only 10% are diagnosed, because early disease is often asymptomatic and existing tests are inaccurate, invasive, or inaccessible. Early diagnosis is key: the disease is fully reversible with weight loss or new therapeutics.

solution.headline: The First & Only Accurate Non-Invasive Blood Test for MASLD
solution.body: LipoNexus is a UC San Diego spinout commercializing the first best-in-class MASLD blood test with greater than 95% accuracy. Our 15-lipid panel, run via mass spectrometry in commercial clinical laboratories, directly measures disease-causing and disease-mediating inflammatory lipid biomarkers — the root cause of the disease.

features.title: Simple Blood Draw
features.description: Detect and diagnose MASLD with a simple blood draw — no imaging, no biopsy, no specialist required.

features.title: 95%+ Accuracy
features.description: 15-lipid panel via mass spectrometry achieves 95%+ accuracy and 99% specificity — highest of any blood test on the market.

features.title: Early Detection
features.description: Identify MASLD at early, fully reversible stages — before symptoms or organ damage appear. Enables routine population screening.

features.title: Therapy Monitoring
features.description: Monitor treatment response to GLP-1 agonists (Wegovy) and new MASLD/MASH therapeutics (Rezdiffra) over time.
